episodes.title: Cult Leader and Family Guilty in Tragic Case | New Zealand News
episodes.description:
A cult leader and his family were found guilty in Auckland of kidnapping, manslaughter, and mishandling human remains after a 70-year-old house guest was murdered and dumped in a harbor with rocks tied to her body. The leader, Kaixiao Liu, called himself “Lord,” and recorded chilling details of how the victim was restrained and silenced. His wife, parents, and the victim—all tied to a secretive religious group—faced multiple charges, though jury deliberations left some charges against the parents unresolved. Evidence from diary entries, sermons, and hidden recordings led investigators to the family, who were arrested trying to flee the country. Sentencing for Liu and his wife is set for August, with undecided charges to be addressed later.
